mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, the labor market's dual indicators signal economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with triggered labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window with triggered INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS by more than 5% MoM indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of months with triggered RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 2% YoY, the combined monetary and inflation signals predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with triggered monetary and inflation conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the labor market's overall health, as measured by UNRATE, drives S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower rates indicating economic strength.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST by more than 10% YoY signals housing market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of mid-cycle expansions with triggered HOUST growth.
